newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine pension fund assets up 91 pct yr to June.
newsitem.headline: Argentine pension fund assets up 91 pct yr to June.

text.p: Assets under management by Argentine private pension funds, known as AFJPs, rose 91.33 percent in June against June last year to $7.34 billion, said the SAFJP, the official fund regulator, Friday.
The regulator said in a statement that funds under management grew 4.55 percent from June and 37.91 percent since the beginning of the year.
The pension fund regulator said AFJPs, which were launched under deregulation in July 1994, showed annual yields of an average 23.48 percent in the year to June.
Government bonds made up 45.5 percent of the AFJPs' portfolios, equities 21.75 percent, fixed-term bank deposits 16.41 percent and mutual funds 4.13 percent, said the SAFJP.
